name: Feature request

labels: enhancement
---

<!--
For open-ended questions or "is this a good idea?" discussions, prefer
Discussions over an issue. Issues are best once there is a concrete change to
propose.
-->

## Problem

What are you trying to do that perch makes hard or impossible today? Describe the
situation, not the solution.

## Proposed solution

What would you like perch to do instead? If you have thoughts on how it should
look or behave in the cockpit, sketch them here.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you weighed, workarounds you use now, or why existing features
do not cover this.

## Additional context

Anything else — the agent (`claude` / `opencode`) or workflow this relates to,
mock-ups, or links to related issues.
